# TRAJECTORY PLOTS 
```{r}

dim(latent_class_trajectories) #28280 measurements (by PID and day), 6 variables 

latent_class_trajectories <- latent_class_trajectories %>%
  mutate(APNS_Outcome = if_else(APNS_Outcome == "Loss", "Depression", as.character(APNS_Outcome)))

days_by_outcome <- latent_class_trajectories %>%
  group_by(APNS_Outcome) %>%
  summarise(Days = list(sort(unique(Day)))) %>%
  mutate(Days = sapply(Days, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ", ")))

# to make the  line plots out to 6 months, I have the select the day that is closest to 6 months for each outcome which is on average 182.5 days 

# anxious = 175 
# avoid = 168 
# hyperarousal = 175 
# depression = 175 
# mental fatigue = 203 
# Nightmare = 161
# pain = 196 
# reexperience = 168 
# sleep = 161 
# somatic = 203 

# Define the dataset with closest days to 6 months
closest_days <- data.frame(
  Outcome = c("Pain", "Reexperience", "Avoidance", "Mental Fatigue", "Hyperarousal", "Somatic", "Anxious", "Depression", "Nightmare", "Sleep"),
  Closest_Day = c(196, 168, 126, 203, 175, 203, 175, 175, 161, 161))

latent_class_trajectories_plot <- latent_class_trajectories %>%
  filter(Class %in% c("Moderate Recovery", "High"))


create_trajectory_plot <- function(data, apns_outcome, closest_days) {

  data_subset <- subset(data, data$APNS == apns_outcome)

  closest_day <- subset(closest_days, closest_days$Outcome == apns_outcome)$Closest_Day
  
  x_pad <- 0.07 * closest_day 
  
  summary <- data_subset %>%
    filter(!is.na(Class)) %>%  
    group_by(Day, Class) %>%
    summarize(Mean_Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
    summary$Class <- factor(summary$Class, levels = c("Low", "Moderate Recovery", 
                                                      "Moderate", "High"))
    max_y <- max(summary$Mean_Score, na.rm = TRUE) 
  
  plot <- ggplot(summary %>% filter(Day <= closest_day), aes(x = Day, y = Mean_Score, color = Class)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) + 
    labs(title =NULL, x = "Months", y = "Score") +  # paste0(apns_outcome)
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = "#AAA8B3", 
                                  "Moderate Recovery" = "#858290", 
                                  "Moderate" = "#514D5B", 
                                  "High" = "#0B090D", name = "Class")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, closest_day), 
                     breaks = c(0 + x_pad , closest_day - x_pad), labels = c("ED", "6M")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_y + 0.2)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(size = 7), 
      axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
      axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = -2)), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", vjust = 2),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black",margin = margin(l = -10), face =  "bold"), 
      legend.position = "none", 
      #legend.title = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"), 
      #legend.text = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"), 
      legend.key.size =unit(0.75, "cm"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 1, fill = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 1, r = 3, b = 1, l = 3, unit = "pt"))
  
  return(plot)
}

trajectory_plots <- list()


# Generate plots for each APNS outcome and save them to the list
for (apns_outcome in unique(latent_class_trajectories$APNS)) {
  trajectory_plots[[apns_outcome]] <- create_trajectory_plot(latent_class_trajectories, apns_outcome, closest_days)
}

line_pain <- trajectory_plots[["Pain"]]
line_pain <- line_pain + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 8.5), breaks = c(0,4,8))

line_reexperience <- trajectory_plots[["Reexperience"]]
line_reexperience <- line_reexperience + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 4), breaks = c(0,2,4))

line_avoidance <- trajectory_plots[["Avoidance"]]
line_avoidance <- line_avoidance + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 4), breaks = c(0,2,4))

line_mentalfatigue <- trajectory_plots[["Mental Fatigue"]]
line_mentalfatigue <- line_mentalfatigue + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 8.5), breaks = c(0,4,8))

line_hyperarousal <- trajectory_plots[["Hyperarousal"]]
line_hyperarousal <- line_hyperarousal + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 4), breaks = c(0,2,4))

line_somatic <- trajectory_plots[["Somatic"]]
line_somatic <- line_somatic + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 9), breaks = c(0, 4,8))

line_anxious <- trajectory_plots[["Anxious"]]
line_anxious <- line_anxious + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 3), breaks = c(0,2))

line_depression <- trajectory_plots[["Depression"]]
line_depression <- line_depression + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 3.5), breaks = c(0,2))

line_nightmare <- trajectory_plots[["Nightmare"]]
line_nightmare <- line_nightmare + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 2.5), breaks = c(0, 2))

line_sleep <- trajectory_plots[["Sleep"]]
line_sleep <- line_sleep + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 2.75), breaks = c(0, 2))

trajectory_order <- list(line_pain, line_avoidance, line_reexperience, line_hyperarousal, line_anxious, line_somatic, line_mentalfatigue, line_depression,line_nightmare, line_sleep )

```

       line_anxious = line_anxious, line_somatic = line_somatic,
       line_mentalfatigue = line_mentalfatigue, line_depression = line_depression,
       line_nightmare = line_nightmare, line_sleep = line_sleep),
  "trajectory_lines")
